# Codex Studio 0.1.15
## Canvas glow restored
- Restores the adaptive wallpaper-colored glow behind the Canvas hero preview. - Keeps the hero artwork and controls cleanly clipped while allowing the glow to breathe around the card, matching the Themes spotlight. - Preserves the local Apple wallpaper library, Favorites and Recent collections, runtime recovery, diagnostics, and Sparkle update flow from 0.1.14.

# Codex Studio 0.1.14
## A steadier local studio
- Re-checks the Codex runtime whenever the app returns to the foreground, so sleep, fast user switching, or a Codex update cannot leave the status surface stale. - Prevents overlapping local catalog scans and guards asynchronous theme apply and restore results against stale updates. - Adds a privacy-conscious Diagnostics panel with copyable runtime/catalog details and a shortcut to the local support folder. - Adds stable accessibility targets for sidebar destinations, theme actions, search, category filtering, and diagnostics controls. - Corrects the accessibility descriptions for Favorites and Recently used so their counts describe the right collection. - Preserves the contained adaptive Canvas glow, offline Apple wallpaper library, Favorites and Recent collections, unified window chrome, DockDoor relaunch recovery, and Sparkle updates.

# Codex Studio 0.1.13
## Adaptive Canvas glow and a denser theme gallery
- Adds the wallpaper-matched adaptive glow from Themes to the Canvas hero while keeping the effect contained behind the preview surface. - Fixes the Themes spotlight bleed that could cover the controls, category rail, and gallery cards. - Groups Platform release sorting into compact macOS, iOS, and iPadOS shelves while preserving oldest-to-newest order within each shelf. - Keeps the offline Apple wallpaper library, Favorites, theme application flow, DockDoor relaunch behavior, and Sparkle updates intact.
